code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, monocytosis, elevated ferritin, CRP, and INR, and mildly increased creatinine. These findings suggest significant inflammation, possible infection, and impaired oxygenation, with evidence of coagulopathy. The pattern may be seen in severe systemic illness such as sepsis, viral infection (e.g., COVID-19), or other causes of acute respiratory distress and multi-organ involvement. Immediate clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
